title: Divorce and deciding to tour with Jaws
summary: Edison says he would not travel while married because he wanted to be near his daughter.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Well, now, when you got together with Jaws, what happened? You play -- you start to play jazz clubs again.

Oh, yeah, yeah, and well, when I really decided to go with him is when I got my divorce, because as long as I was married, I didn't want to travel too much. I loved being around my daughter. And she is all I have and --
Well, you've got your mother, too.
Well, my mother is -- you know, she's lived her life.
My daughter has hers to live. And I'm trying to make a future for her.
